analysis: The trial completed successfully but reduced host validation macro HR@10 to 0.5025, down 0.0300 from the stated 0.5325 reference. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.530, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.545, Electronics 0.395, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.540. Electronics declined from the stated 0.430 reference by 0.035. These results do not support the combined change to equal per-sequence weighting and a 20-target supervision half-life; this trial cannot isolate which component caused the decline. No held-out test improvement is established.
code_summary: Retained four independently trained, dataset-routed SASRec models with two causal attention blocks, 64-dimensional embeddings, two attention heads, and a gated preference branch using a ten-interaction exponential half-life. Changed only ranking-loss aggregation: positive-plus-64-negative cross-entropy receives recency weights with a 20-valid-target half-life, normalized within each sequence and averaged over nonempty sequences. Added deterministic checks for padding, empty/singleton rows, weight ratios, reference agreement, and finite gradients. Preserved inference architecture, predictor writer, sampling, optimizer, checkpoint selection, seeds, and dataset routing.
